en: HG GM

The "1/144 Scale HG GM" Gunpla.

The GM is an Earth Federation Forces machine from "Mobile
Suit Gundam". It was redesigned as a mass-production type
based on data from the Gundam, the prototype mobile suit
developed under Operation V.

Costs were cut throughout, for example with a goggle-type
dual sensor in the head. Its generator output and armor
are lower than the Gundam's, but its lighter weight keeps
it mobile.
HG Zaku II

The "1/144 Scale HG Mass Production Type Zaku" (Zaku II)
Gunpla.

The Zaku II is a Zeon machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam"
and the successor to the Zaku I, the first mass-produced
mobile suit of the Universal Century. Deployed in great
numbers, it dealt the Earth Federation Forces a
devastating blow and gave Zeon the upper hand early in the
war.

Its mono-eye, the power pipes all over the body and the
spiked shoulder armor are its trademarks. A versatile
machine that is easy to customize with other weapons or
for other environments, it has many variants.
HG Char's Zaku II

The "1/144 Scale HG Char Aznable's Zaku II" Gunpla.

Char's Zaku II is the machine piloted by Char Aznable, the
"Red Comet", in "Mobile Suit Gundam". It is a
commander-type Zaku II with a blade antenna on its head,
painted red, Char's personal color.

Its thrust is only about 30％ higher than a normal Zaku
II's, but Char's superb piloting gave it overwhelming
mobility, and the Federation feared it as the machine that
moves "three times faster than normal".
HG Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam" Gunpla.

The Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam". A
high-performance prototype developed under the Earth
Federation Forces' Operation V, packed with the latest
technology of its day. Together with the skill of its
pilot, Amuro Ray, it achieved results great enough to
change the course of the One Year War, and Zeon feared it
as "the Federation's White Devil".

The V-shaped blade antenna on its forehead, its twin-eye
sensor camera and its white, red and blue tricolor are its
trademarks, and this design has been passed down to every
Gundam-type machine since.
HG Dom

The "1/144 Scale HG Dom" Gunpla.

The Dom is a Zeon machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam". A
heavy ground mobile suit that can hover with the jet
engines in its legs and excels at hit-and-run tactics,
using its high mobility and heavy armor.

Its sturdy, bottom-heavy build and the cross-shaped
mono-eye slit on its head are its trademarks. The "Jet
Stream Attack" by three Doms of the Black Tri-Stars, Gaia,
Ortega and Mash, is famous.
HG GM Command

The "1/144 Scale HG GM Command (Space Type)" Gunpla. For
this battle event, which lets you customize, the space
type was chosen to match the GM's colors.

The GM Command is an Earth Federation Forces machine from
"Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket" and other
works.

One of the late-production GMs developed at the end of the
One Year War, it improves on the early mass-production GM
in basic performance and communications, and on paper it
is a match for the Gundam.
HG Dom Tropen

The "1/144 Scale HG Dom Tropen" Gunpla.

The Dom Tropen is a heavy mobile suit for desert and
tropical use from "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust
Memory" and other works. "Tropen" is German for "tropics".

A Dom redesigned and improved for local combat, with
stronger armor and better mobility. Its leg jet engines
are fitted with dust filters for fighting in deserts and
extreme heat.
HG GM Custom

The "1/144 Scale HG GM Custom" Gunpla.

The GM Custom is an Earth Federation Forces
mass-production mobile suit, a step up from the GM, from
"Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory" and other
works.

Built after the One Year War as an improved GM, it was the
best mass-production machine of the Federation at the
time. Its basic performance is far higher than the GM's
and it is very versatile, but it is a safe machine with
few standout features, and it is sometimes said that "its
feature is having no features".
HG Gundam Mk-II

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Mk-II (AEUG Colors)" Gunpla.
The regular kit comes with the Flying Armor, but this set
made only for Gunpla Battle events leaves out the Flying
Armor runners and contains the Gundam Mk-II alone.

The Gundam Mk-II is a machine from "Mobile Suit Zeta
Gundam". Developed by the Titans, it was later stolen by
the AEUG and repainted from dark blue to white.

A groundbreaking machine, the first to use a movable
frame, with excellent mobility and high overall
performance. As Kamille Bidan's first machine, it fought
in many battles and achieved much.
HG Hyaku-Shiki

The "1/144 Scale HG Hyaku-Shiki" Gunpla.

The Hyaku-Shiki is the machine of Lieutenant Quattro
Bajeena of the anti-Federation group AEUG in "Mobile Suit
Zeta Gundam", best known for its golden armor. Its chief
developer, Dr. M. Nagano, named it Hyaku-Shiki ("Type
100") in the hope that it would be "an MS that lasts a
hundred years".

A light body thanks to its movable frame, many
attitude-control verniers and the binders on its backpack
give it great mobility, but drawing out its full
performance takes extremely delicate piloting.
HG Zeta Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Zeta Gundam" Gunpla.

The Zeta Gundam is the machine of Kamille Bidan, the hero
of "Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam". One of the high-performance
MS developed under Project Z, it is classed as a
third-generation MS that surpasses existing MS.

The Flying Armor on its back, its long-tail vernier
stabilizer and the thrusters in its shins allow fast, very
free movement. It also secretly carries a bio-sensor,
which works only under certain conditions and can give the
machine astonishing abilities.
HG Geara Doga

The "1/144 Scale HG Geara Doga" Gunpla.

The Geara Doga is the general-purpose mass-production
mobile suit that is the mainstay of the new Neo Zeon in
"Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack".

It follows the look and structure of the Zaku II, Zeon's
iconic machine, with an asymmetric shape: a shield on the
right shoulder and spiked armor on the left. A solid,
expandable design that is easy to pilot and maintain makes
it an excellent practical weapon.
HG Qubeley

The "1/144 Scale HG Qubeley" Gunpla.

The Qubeley is a Newtype-only prototype designed and
developed in Axis, from "Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam" and
other works. It was the personal machine of the Newtype
Haman Karn, the real leader of Axis.

The large flexible binders on its shoulders give it
acrobatic mobility in space. Its back container carries
its greatest feature, the remote-guided attack units
called "funnels", which let it attack from every direction
with no blind spot.
HG Nu Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Nu Gundam" Gunpla.

The Nu Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam:
Char's Counterattack", a Newtype-only machine Amuro Ray
designed for himself.

A well-balanced machine that combines top-class
performance for its time with high reliability as a
weapon, and the psycho-frame used in part of its body
gives it excellent response and agility.

Its greatest feature is the "Fin Funnels" on its backpack:
plate-shaped wireless weapons with a small generator and a
mega particle deflector, which fire far stronger beams
than earlier psycommu weapons.
HG Hi-Nu Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Hi-Nu Gundam" Gunpla.

The Hi-Nu Gundam is a Newtype-only mobile suit from the
novel "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack -
Beltorchika's Children", and a variant of the Nu Gundam.

It is colored mainly white and blue, and carries a
long-tail vernier stabilizer like the Zeta Gundam's and
propellant tanks on its back. Unlike the Nu Gundam, its
Fin Funnels are mounted symmetrically on racks that
recharge them.
HG Sazabi

The "1/144 Scale HG Sazabi" Gunpla.

The Sazabi is the personal machine of Char Aznable,
supreme leader of the new Neo Zeon, in "Mobile Suit
Gundam: Char's Counterattack". A large machine 26m tall,
painted red, Char's personal color.

It combines high durability with the functions of a
Newtype-only machine, and thanks to its psycho-frame it is
more mobile than earlier machines despite being a large,
heavy MS. It can also make all-range attacks with its
funnels, and performs well in every respect.
HG God Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG God Gundam" Gunpla.

The God Gundam is Neo Japan's Mobile Fighter in the 13th
Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam".

Its Mobile Trace System copies its pilot's every move, and
it uses the same martial-arts attacks as its pilot Domon
Kasshu, champion of the colonies' fighting arts.

Its special moves include the "Erupting Burning God
Finger", which gathers the energy amplified by the
generator on its back into its palm and releases it all at
once.
HG Master Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Master Gundam" Gunpla. The regular kit
comes with the mobile horse Fuunsaiki, but this set made
only for Gunpla Battle events leaves out the Fuunsaiki
runners and contains the Master Gundam alone.

The Master Gundam is Neo Hong Kong's Mobile Fighter in the
13th Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam".

It uses the same martial-arts attacks as its pilot, Master
Asia, and has many powerful special moves, such as the
"Darkness Finger", the "Choukyuu Haou Den'eidan" and the
"Juuni Ouhouhai Daisharin".
HG Nobel Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Nobel Gundam" Gunpla.

The Nobel Gundam is Neo Sweden's Mobile Fighter in the
13th Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam". It looks
like a long-haired woman in a sailor uniform. Besides the
rhythmic-gymnastics fighting style of its pilot Allenby
Beardsley, it also uses martial-arts attacks learned to
keep up with her friend Domon.

In the Battle Simulator it counts as "a machine with no
backpack part". Instead, a "Beargguy" backpack part (the
Beargguy Randoseru) that suits the Nobel Gundam's image is
provided and can be found during battle.
HG Wing Gundam Zero (EW)

The "1/144 Scale HG Wing Gundam Zero (EW)" Gunpla. (Not to
be sold)
HG Gundam Heavyarms (EW)

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Heavyarms (EW)" Gunpla. (Not to
be sold)
HG Gundam Deathscythe H (EW)

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Deathscythe H (EW)" Gunpla.
(Not to be sold)
HG Aile Strike Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Aile Strike Gundam" Gunpla.

The Aile Strike Gundam is the Strike Gundam, the first
machine of Kira Yamato, hero of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED",
equipped with the "Aile Striker", a Striker Pack for
high-mobility combat.

The Strike Gundam is one of the GAT-X series developed by
the Atlantic Federation, a member of the Earth Alliance,
under its "G-Weapon Development Project". Its greatest
feature is changing equipment with the "Striker Pack
System". The Aile Striker, one of those Striker Packs,
boosts mobility and allows short flights.
HG Launcher Strike Gundam

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/144 Scale Launcher Strike Gundam" converted
to HG spec. The box is the 1/144 scale one, but it
contains HG-spec runners.

The Launcher Strike Gundam is the Strike Gundam equipped
with the "Launcher Striker", a Striker Pack for
bombardment. It specializes in shooting with the Combo
Weapon Pod on its right shoulder and the large beam cannon
"Agni", a hyper-impulse cannon.
HG Sword Strike Gundam

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/144 Scale Sword Strike Gundam" converted to
HG spec. The box is the 1/144 scale one, but it contains
HG-spec runners.

The Sword Strike Gundam is the Strike Gundam equipped with
the "Sword Striker", a Striker Pack for close combat. It
specializes in close combat with the "Schwert Gewehr", a
huge anti-ship sword as long as an MS is tall, and the
"Midas Messer", a beam boomerang mounted on its left
shoulder.
HG Strike Rouge + IWSP

The "1/144 Scale HG Strike Rouge + IWSP" Gunpla.

The Strike Rouge, an ORB machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED" and "SEED DESTINY", equipped with the "IWSP", the
Integrated Weapons Striker Pack.

The Strike Rouge is a dead copy of the Strike Gundam, but
various adjustments made it perform better than the
original. The IWSP is a multi-purpose Striker Pack that
combines the functions of the Aile, Sword and Launcher
packs: on top of the Aile Striker's mobility, it carries
large-caliber railguns for long range and anti-ship swords
for close combat.
HG Freedom Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Freedom Gundam" Gunpla.

The Freedom Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED" and "SEED DESTINY". It was developed by ZAFT, but
Kira Yamato took it and made it his own.

Its nuclear engine gives its weapons far greater output,
letting it fire its long-range, high-power guns at once:
the Xiphias rail cannons on its waist and the Balaena
plasma beam cannons on its back. Its greatest feature, the
ten wing binders on its back, change shape between
High-Mat Mode and Full Burst Mode as the situation
demands.
HG Strike Freedom Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Strike Freedom Gundam" Gunpla.

The Strike Freedom Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Gundam SEED DESTINY". Built as the personal machine of
Kira Yamato, the Ultimate Coordinator, it pushes every
spec to the limit.

It has the Xiphias 3 rail cannons developed from the
Freedom's weapons, the powerful Callidus multi-phase beam
cannon in its abdomen, all-range attacks with the Super
DRAGOON mobile weapon wings on its back, and the Full
Burst that fires all of these together with its
high-energy beam rifles, giving it astonishing firepower.
HG Astray Red Frame

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Astray Red Frame" Gunpla.

The Astray Red Frame is one of the P0 series prototypes
secretly developed by ORB's Morgenroete in "Mobile Suit
Gundam SEED ASTRAY". The junk dealer Lowe Guele found it
when Heliopolis was destroyed and made it his own.

It uses the flexible frame of the P0 series, which can
move almost like a human, to fight with Bajiquan and
swordplay. Its greatest feature is the "Gerbera Straight"
at its waist, a katana for MS with a blade of fearsome
sharpness and durability.
HG Astray Red Frame Kai

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Astray Red Frame Kai" Gunpla.
(Not to be sold)
HG Astray Blue Frame

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Astray Blue Frame" Gunpla.

The Astray Blue Frame is one of the P0 series prototypes
secretly developed by ORB's Morgenroete in "Mobile Suit
Gundam SEED ASTRAY". The junk dealer Lowe Guele found it
when Heliopolis was destroyed, and Gai Murakumo of the
mercenary unit Serpent Tail took it over.

It was developed as "a test machine for option equipment
specs" and can use all kinds of weapons. Its structure
also makes it fairly easy to add option sets to suit the
situation.
HG Astray Blue Frame Second Revise

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Astray Blue Frame Second
Revise" Gunpla. (Not to be sold)
HG Astray Green Frame

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Astray Green Frame" Gunpla.

The Astray Green Frame is one of the P0 series prototypes
secretly developed by Morgenroete in "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED FRAME ASTRAYS". Former ORB soldier Barry Ho took it
over, and later passed it on to Toroya Noiret, a young
anti-government guerrilla.

Its sensors and AI work together to analyze the battle and
dodge with great skill. It excels at hand-to-hand combat,
which Toroya learned from Barry, the "Fist God". Its green
frame and armor were painted after it was assigned to
jungle use.
HG 00 Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG 00 Gundam" Gunpla.

The 00 Gundam is the machine of Setsuna F. Seiei, a Gundam
Meister of Celestial Being, in "Mobile Suit Gundam 00".

It was the first machine with the Twin Drive System, which
runs two GN Drives in sync to square the amount of GN
particles produced. Syncing the drives is difficult and it
never ran fully stable on its own, but even so the Twin
Drive's high output gives it astonishing power that
overwhelms all others.
HG 00 Raiser

The "1/144 Scale HG 00 Raiser" Gunpla.

The 00 Raiser is the 00 Gundam from "Mobile Suit Gundam
00" docked with its support unit, the O Raiser.

The stabilizer in the O Raiser brings the Twin Drive
System fully into sync, unlocking 100％ of its true
performance. Seen as an MS beyond Gundam, it is called the
00 Raiser, without "Gundam" in its name. When it activates
"Trans-Am", releasing all its stored high-density
particles, its strength is on another level entirely.
HG Susanowo

The "1/144 Scale HG Susanowo" Gunpla.

The Susanowo is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam 00", an
upgraded version of the Masurao, a close-combat machine
built for Mr. Bushido and his obsession with defeating the
Gundams.

Its armor is shaped like a samurai's, and it is armed with
the enhanced sabers "Shiranui" and "Unryu". Like the
Masurao, it can activate Trans-Am even though it runs on a
pseudo-solar furnace.
HG Unicorn Gundam (Unicorn Mode)

The "1/144 Scale HG Unicorn Gundam (Unicorn Mode)" Gunpla.

The Unicorn Gundam is an Earth Federation Forces
anti-Newtype Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit
Gundam Unicorn". Developed as the final stage of the "UC
Project", it is the first machine ever built with a full
psycho-frame, and responds to its pilot far better than
earlier psycho-frame machines.

Its normal form, before the NT-D system activates, is
called "Unicorn Mode", and is known for its pure white
color and the single-horn blade antenna on its head.
HG Banshee (Unicorn Mode)

The "1/144 Scale HG Banshee (Unicorn Mode)" Gunpla.

The Banshee is an Earth Federation Forces anti-Newtype
Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn".
"Banshee" is a nickname; its official name is "Unicorn
Gundam Unit 2".

It has black armor, and its head antenna is a row of
golden horns. Where Unit 1 is modeled on a unicorn, this
one is modeled on a lion, with a sinister design. Tuned
with feedback from Unit 1's data, it is even more refined
than Unit 1.
HG Unicorn Gundam (Destroy Mode)

The "1/144 Scale HG Unicorn Gundam (Destroy Mode)" Gunpla.

The Unicorn Gundam is an Earth Federation Forces
anti-Newtype Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit
Gundam Unicorn".

When it senses a hostile Newtype and the "NT-D system"
activates, its body expands, exposing an inner frame that
glows red, and its blade antenna splits into a V to reveal
a Gundam-type face. This state is called "Destroy Mode".
In Destroy Mode its performance, above all its mobility,
leaps up, letting it fight at speeds that look like
teleportation.
HG Banshee (Destroy Mode)

The "1/144 Scale HG Banshee (Destroy Mode)" Gunpla.

The Banshee is an Earth Federation Forces anti-Newtype
Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn".
Its official name is "Unicorn Gundam Unit 2".

When the NT-D system activates and the Banshee enters
"Destroy Mode", the psycho-frame exposed between its armor
glows gold, and its head antenna takes a shape like a
lion's mane.
HG Sinanju

The "1/144 Scale HG Sinanju" Gunpla.

The Sinanju is the machine of Full Frontal, leader of the
Neo Zeon remnant "the Sleeves", in "Mobile Suit Gundam
Unicorn".

A Newtype-only machine that uses psycho-frame in part of
its body, it is in a sense a sibling of the Unicorn
Gundam. After the Sleeves stole it, it was modified with
improved controls and stronger thrusters, and repainted
crimson from head to toe.

For its overwhelming combat power and crimson look, it and
its pilot Frontal are called "the Red Comet reborn".
HG Zaku Minelayer

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/144 Scale Zaku Minelayer" converted to HG
spec. The box is the 1/144 scale one, but it contains
HG-spec runners.

The Zaku Minelayer, from "Mobile Suit Variations (MSV)",
is a Zaku II F whose backpack was replaced with a large
backpack for laying mines.

It can operate longer than a normal Zaku II F and has
communications as good as a commander's machine, but the
weight of the backpack makes it sluggish.
HG Garma Zabi's Zaku II FS Type

The "1/144 Scale HG Garma Zabi's Zaku II FS Type" Gunpla.

Garma Zabi's Zaku II FS Type is a Principality of Zeon
machine from "Mobile Suit Variations (MSV)", the personal
machine of Garma Zabi, fourth son of Sovereign Degwin
Zabi.

It has improved melee ability and four vulcan guns in its
head, but its basic abilities are not much different from
a normal Zaku II F. It is less a "high-performance
machine" than a "luxury machine".
HG High Mobility Type Zaku II

The "1/144 Scale HG Shin Matsunaga's Zaku II" (High
Mobility Type Zaku II) Gunpla.

Shin Matsunaga's Zaku II is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Variations (MSV)". Its model is an improved High Mobility
Type Zaku II (MS-06R-1A).

A high-mobility space combat version developed to improve
on the Zaku II F. It looks much like earlier Zakus, but
its internals changed so much that it is effectively a
different mobile suit.
HG Johnny Ridden's Zaku II

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/144 Scale Johnny Ridden's Zaku II"
converted to HG spec. The box is the 1/144 scale one, but
it contains HG-spec runners.

Johnny Ridden's Zaku II is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Variations (MSV)": the one Major Johnny Ridden piloted of
the only four late-type High Mobility Zaku IIs (MS-06R-2)
ever built.

It was changed so much from the R-1A that it is
practically a different machine, and was even called "a
Gelgoog in Zaku's clothing".
HG Dom Tropen (Sand Brown)

The "1/144 Scale HG Dom Tropen (Sand Brown)" Gunpla.

The Dom Tropen (Sand Brown) is a heavy mobile suit for
desert and tropical use from "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083:
Stardust Memory" and other works, painted for desert
combat.

A Dom redesigned and improved for local combat, with
stronger armor and better mobility. Its leg jet engines
are fitted with dust filters for fighting in deserts and
extreme heat.
HG Qubeley Mk-II

The "1/144 Scale HG Qubeley Mk-II" Gunpla.

The Qubeley Mk-II is a Neo Zeon Newtype-only machine from
"Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", piloted by Elpeo Ple.

A minor update of the original Qubeley piloted by Haman
Karn, developed with mass production in mind. It is
slightly detuned from the original, but its outstanding
mobility and all-range funnel attacks are intact, and it
is among the best-performing MS of Neo Zeon.
HG G-3 Gundam
The "1/144 Scale HG G-3 Gundam" Gunpla. (Not to be sold.)
HG Gundam Mk-II Titans

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam Mk-II (Titans Colors)" Gunpla.

The Gundam Mk-II (Titans Colors) is a machine from "Mobile
Suit Zeta Gundam". The true successor to the Gundam,
developed by the Earth Federation special forces Titans
from the legendary "Gundam" with the latest technology.

A groundbreaking machine, the first to use a movable
frame, with excellent mobility and high overall
performance. Unlike the original tricolor Gundam, it is
painted the dark blue known as "Titans colors".
HG Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga

The "1/144 Scale HG Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga" Gunpla.

Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Gundam: Char's Counterattack": the Geara Doga, the new Neo
Zeon's main mass-production machine, modified as a
commander's machine for Rezin Schnyder.

It is painted blue, Rezin Schnyder's personal color, and
the commander's blade antenna on its head improves its
communications.
HG Freedom Gundam (*First-Print Bonus)

*First-print bonus: the "1/144 Scale HG Freedom Gundam"
Gunpla.

The Freedom Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED" and "SEED DESTINY". It was developed by ZAFT, but
Kira Yamato took it and made it his own.

Its nuclear engine gives its weapons far greater output,
letting it fire its long-range, high-power guns at once:
the Xiphias rail cannons on its waist and the Balaena
plasma beam cannons on its back. Its greatest feature, the
ten wing binders on its back, change shape between
High-Mat Mode and Full Burst Mode as the situation
demands.
HG Dreissen

The "1/144 Scale HG Dreissen (Unicorn Ver.)" Gunpla.

The Dreissen is a Neo Zeon mass-production heavy mobile
suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" and "Mobile Suit Gundam
Unicorn". In "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn" it was
repainted, given the Sleeves' decorations and used to
defend the Neo Zeon remnant "the Sleeves".

The final development of the Dom line, with a sturdy build
and high mobility. Unlike the Dom, which focuses on
bombardment, it is armed for close range with a beam
tomahawk, Tri-Blades and more.
HG ZZ Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG ZZ Gundam" Gunpla.

The ZZ Gundam is a general-purpose heavy assault mobile
suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", an AEUG machine piloted
by the hero Judau Ashta.

A high-performance machine with high output, high mobility
and high firepower: it has several generators, each strong
enough to run an MS on its own, and battleship-class
weapons led by the High Mega Cannon. It stands at one peak
of the "dinosaur-like evolution" of the late U.C. 0080s,
when a single MS was expected to do everything.
HG Turn A Gundam

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/144 Scale Turn A Gundam" converted to HG
spec. The box is the 1/144 scale one, but it contains
HG-spec runners.

The Turn A Gundam is a machine from "Turn A Gundam",
piloted by Loran Cehack and used by the Inglessa Militia
and others.

A mysterious machine that emerged from a stone statue in a
Mountain Cycle, called the "White Doll" or "Mustache" for
its looks. In truth it is the machine said to have "buried
Earth's civilization" by turning every man-made thing in
the Earth Sphere to sand with its "Moonlight Butterfly"
system, and it holds immeasurable hidden power.
HG Crossbone Gundam X1

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/144 Scale HG Crossbone Gundam X1" Gunpla.

The Crossbone Gundam X1 is the MS used by Kincade Nau of
the space pirates Crossbone Vanguard in "Mobile Suit
Crossbone Gundam".

Its pirate-style decorations and large X-shaped back
thrusters are its trademarks. The first MS built in the
Earth Sphere for the outer planets, its back thrusters
keep it highly mobile even in Jupiter's strong gravity.
Designed for close combat, it carries many close-combat
weapons all over its body.
HG Destiny Gundam

The "1/144 Scale HG Destiny Gundam" Gunpla.

The Destiny Gundam is the ultimate all-purpose machine
from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY", packed with all of
ZAFT's best technology to end the war with the Earth
Alliance.

Its "Hyper Deuterion" engine gives it enormous output, and
its many high-output weapons for every situation give it
the firepower and mobility to overwhelm enemies at any
range, near or far.
HG Gundam X

The "1/144 Scale HG Gundam X" Gunpla.

The Gundam X is a decisive-battle MS developed by the
former Earth Federation Forces as a trump card in the 7th
Space War, in "After War Gundam X". After the war, Garrod
Ran found it and made it his own.

Its greatest feature is the strategic weapon on its back,
the "Satellite Cannon", which at full output can destroy a
colony in one shot. Its basic performance as an MS is also
high, with sturdy armor and great versatility on any
terrain.
HG Build Strike Gundam Full Package

The "1/144 Scale HG Build Strike Gundam Full Package"
Gunpla.

The Build Strike Gundam Full Package is a Gunpla from
"Gundam Build Fighters" that combines the Build Strike
Gundam, custom-built by Sei Iori, with the Build Booster
flight unit.

It is very mobile and excels at quick attacks. It is built
with great skill on the base of the Strike Gundam from
"Mobile Suit Gundam SEED", but its weapons are still
unfinished and there is room to grow. A Gunpla that will
keep evolving.
MG GM

The "1/100 Scale MG GM" Gunpla.

The GM is an Earth Federation Forces machine from "Mobile
Suit Gundam". It was redesigned as a mass-production type
based on data from the Gundam, the prototype mobile suit
developed under Operation V.

Costs were cut throughout, for example with a goggle-type
dual sensor in the head. Its generator output and armor
are lower than the Gundam's, but its lighter weight keeps
it mobile.
MG Zaku II

The "1/100 Scale MG Zaku II" Gunpla.

The Zaku II is a Zeon machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam"
and the successor to the Zaku I, the first mass-produced
mobile suit of the Universal Century. Deployed in great
numbers, it dealt the Earth Federation Forces a
devastating blow and gave Zeon the upper hand early in the
war.

Its mono-eye, the power pipes all over the body and the
spiked shoulder armor are its trademarks. A versatile
machine that is easy to customize with other weapons or
for other environments, it has many variants.
MG Char's Zaku II

The "1/100 Scale MG Char Aznable's Zaku II" Gunpla.

Char's Zaku II is the machine piloted by Char Aznable, the
"Red Comet", in "Mobile Suit Gundam". It is a
commander-type Zaku II with a blade antenna on its head,
painted red, Char's personal color.

Its thrust is only about 30％ higher than a normal Zaku
II's, but Char's superb piloting gave it overwhelming
mobility, and the Federation feared it as the machine that
moves "three times faster than normal".
MG Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam" Gunpla.

The Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam". A
high-performance prototype developed under the Earth
Federation Forces' Operation V, packed with the latest
technology of its day. Together with the skill of its
pilot, Amuro Ray, it achieved results great enough to
change the course of the One Year War, and Zeon feared it
as "the Federation's White Devil".

The V-shaped blade antenna on its forehead, its twin-eye
sensor camera and its white, red and blue tricolor are its
trademarks, and this design has been passed down to every
Gundam-type machine since.
MG Dom

The "1/100 Scale MG Dom" Gunpla.

The Dom is a Zeon machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam". A
heavy ground mobile suit that can hover with the jet
engines in its legs and excels at hit-and-run tactics,
using its high mobility and heavy armor.

Its sturdy, bottom-heavy build and the cross-shaped
mono-eye slit on its head are its trademarks. The "Jet
Stream Attack" by three Doms of the Black Tri-Stars, Gaia,
Ortega and Mash, is famous.
MG GM Command

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG GM Command (Space Type)" Gunpla.

The GM Command is an Earth Federation Forces machine from
"Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket" and other
works.

One of the late-production GMs developed at the end of the
One Year War, it improves on the early mass-production GM
in basic performance and communications, and on paper it
is a match for the Gundam.
MG Dom Tropen

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Dom Tropen" Gunpla.

The Dom Tropen is a heavy mobile suit for desert and
tropical use from "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust
Memory" and other works.

A Dom redesigned and improved for local combat, with
stronger armor and better mobility. Its leg jet engines
are fitted with dust filters for fighting in deserts and
extreme heat.
MG GM Custom

The "1/100 Scale MG GM Custom" Gunpla.

The GM Custom is an Earth Federation Forces
mass-production mobile suit, a step up from the GM, from
"Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory" and other
works.

Built after the One Year War as an improved GM, it was the
best mass-production machine of the Federation at the
time. Its basic performance is far higher than the GM's
and it is very versatile, but it is a safe machine with
few standout features, and it is sometimes said that "its
feature is having no features".
MG Gundam Mk-II

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Mk-II (AEUG Colors)" Gunpla.

The Gundam Mk-II is a machine from "Mobile Suit Zeta
Gundam", the true successor to the Gundam, developed from
the legendary "Gundam" with the latest technology. It was
developed by the Titans, but later stolen by the AEUG, who
repainted it from dark blue to white.

A groundbreaking machine, the first to use a movable
frame, with excellent mobility and high overall
performance. As Kamille Bidan's first machine, it fought
in many battles and achieved much.
MG Hyaku-Shiki

The "1/100 Scale MG Hyaku-Shiki" Gunpla.

The Hyaku-Shiki is the machine of Lieutenant Quattro
Bajeena of the anti-Federation group AEUG in "Mobile Suit
Zeta Gundam", best known for its golden armor. Its chief
developer, Dr. M. Nagano, named it Hyaku-Shiki ("Type
100") in the hope that it would be "an MS that lasts a
hundred years".

A light body thanks to its movable frame, many
attitude-control verniers and the binders on its backpack
give it great mobility, but drawing out its full
performance takes extremely delicate piloting.
MG Zeta Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Zeta Gundam" Gunpla.

The Zeta Gundam is the machine of Kamille Bidan, the hero
of "Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam". One of the high-performance
MS developed under Project Z, it is classed as a
third-generation MS that surpasses existing MS.

The Flying Armor on its back, its long-tail vernier
stabilizer and the thrusters in its shins allow fast, very
free movement. It also secretly carries a bio-sensor,
which works only under certain conditions and can give the
machine astonishing abilities.
MG Geara Doga

The "1/100 Scale MG Geara Doga" Gunpla.

The Geara Doga is the general-purpose mass-production
mobile suit that is the mainstay of the new Neo Zeon in
"Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack".

It follows the look and structure of the Zaku II, Zeon's
iconic machine, with an asymmetric shape: a shield on the
right shoulder and spiked armor on the left. A solid,
expandable design that is easy to pilot and maintain makes
it an excellent practical weapon.
MG Qubeley

The "1/100 Scale MG Qubeley" Gunpla.

The Qubeley is a Newtype-only prototype designed and
developed in Axis, from "Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam" and
other works. It was the personal machine of the Newtype
Haman Karn, the real leader of Axis.

The large flexible binders on its shoulders give it
acrobatic mobility in space. Its back container carries
its greatest feature, the remote-guided attack units
called "funnels", which let it attack from every direction
with no blind spot.
MG Nu Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Nu Gundam" Gunpla.

The Nu Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam:
Char's Counterattack", a Newtype-only machine Amuro Ray
designed for himself.

A well-balanced machine that combines top-class
performance for its time with high reliability as a
weapon, and the psycho-frame used in part of its body
gives it excellent response and agility.

Its greatest feature is the "Fin Funnels" on its backpack:
plate-shaped wireless weapons with a small generator and a
mega particle deflector, which fire far stronger beams
than earlier psycommu weapons.
MG Hi-Nu Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Hi-Nu Gundam" Gunpla.

The Hi-Nu Gundam is a Newtype-only mobile suit from the
novel "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack -
Beltorchika's Children", and a variant of the Nu Gundam.

It is colored mainly white and blue, and carries a
long-tail vernier stabilizer like the Zeta Gundam's and
propellant tanks on its back. Unlike the Nu Gundam, its
Fin Funnels are mounted symmetrically on racks that
recharge them.
MG Sazabi

The "1/100 Scale MG Sazabi" Gunpla.

The Sazabi is the personal machine of Char Aznable,
supreme leader of the new Neo Zeon, in "Mobile Suit
Gundam: Char's Counterattack". A large machine 26m tall,
painted red, Char's personal color.

It combines high durability with the functions of a
Newtype-only machine, and thanks to its psycho-frame it is
more mobile than earlier machines despite being a large,
heavy MS. It can also make all-range attacks with its
funnels, and performs well in every respect.
MG God Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG God Gundam" Gunpla.

The God Gundam is Neo Japan's Mobile Fighter in the 13th
Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam".

Its Mobile Trace System copies its pilot's every move, and
it uses the same martial-arts attacks as its pilot Domon
Kasshu, champion of the colonies' fighting arts.

Its special moves include the "Erupting Burning God
Finger", which gathers the energy amplified by the
generator on its back into its palm and releases it all at
once.
MG Master Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Master Gundam" Gunpla.

The Master Gundam is Neo Hong Kong's Mobile Fighter in the
13th Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam".

It uses the same martial-arts attacks as its pilot, Master
Asia, and has many powerful special moves, such as the
"Darkness Finger", the "Choukyuu Haou Den'eidan" and the
"Juuni Ouhouhai Daisharin".
MG Nobel Gundam

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Nobel Gundam" Gunpla.

The Nobel Gundam is Neo Sweden's Mobile Fighter in the
13th Gundam Fight in "Mobile Fighter G Gundam". It looks
like a long-haired woman in a sailor uniform. Besides the
rhythmic-gymnastics fighting style of its pilot Allenby
Beardsley, it also uses martial-arts attacks learned to
keep up with her friend Domon.
MG Wing Gundam Zero (EW)

The "1/100 Scale MG Wing Gundam Zero (EW)" Gunpla.

The Wing Gundam Zero (EW) is a machine from "Gundam Wing:
Endless Waltz", a refined version of the machine of the
same name from the TV series. Its distinctive design
carries four angel-like wings on its back.

"Wing" comes from the wings on its back, and "Zero" from
it being Gundam Unit 0 of the A.C. world and from the
"ZERO System" it carries. Designed for pure performance
with no regard for practicality, its design data was once
sealed away because it was so dangerous. Its main weapon
is the Twin Buster Rifle, with excessive firepower.
MG Gundam Heavyarms (EW)

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Heavyarms (EW)" Gunpla.

The Gundam Heavyarms (EW) is a refined version of the TV
series Heavyarms, worked out backwards from the Gundam
Heavyarms Kai of "Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz".

One of the five Gundams that descended to Earth in
Operation Meteor. As its name says, it is an artillery
machine with all kinds of heavy weapons built in all over
its body, with total firepower to rival a battleship. Its
"Full Open Attack", which fires every weapon on its body
at once, has overwhelming suppressing power.
MG Gundam Deathscythe H (EW)

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Deathscythe H (EW)" Gunpla.

The Gundam Deathscythe H (EW) is a machine from "Gundam
Wing: Endless Waltz", a refined version of the machine of
the same name from the TV series.

Its trademarks are the Active Cloak on its back, shaped
like bat wings, and its main weapon, the huge
scythe-shaped Beam Scissors. Using its stealth and
mobility to close in on enemy MS and strike with the Beam
Scissors, it is the very image of the Grim Reaper.
MG Aile Strike Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Aile Strike Gundam" Gunpla.

The Aile Strike Gundam is the Strike Gundam, the first
machine of Kira Yamato, hero of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED",
equipped with the "Aile Striker", a Striker Pack for
high-mobility combat.

The Strike Gundam is one of the GAT-X series developed by
the Atlantic Federation, a member of the Earth Alliance,
under its "G-Weapon Development Project". Its greatest
feature is changing equipment with the "Striker Pack
System". The Aile Striker, one of those Striker Packs,
boosts mobility and allows short flights.
MG Launcher/Sword Strike Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Launcher/Sword Strike Gundam" Gunpla:
the MG Strike Gundam with both the Launcher Striker and
the Sword Striker.

It comes with parts for both the Launcher Striker, with
the hyper-impulse cannon "Agni", and the Sword Striker,
with the huge anti-ship sword "Schwert Gewehr", so it can
be built as either the Launcher Strike Gundam or the Sword
Strike Gundam.
MG Strike Rouge

The "1/100 Scale MG Strike Rouge" Gunpla.

The Strike Rouge is the machine of Cagalli Yula Athha in
"Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" and "SEED DESTINY", an ORB
machine. This kit shows it with the Aile Striker.

The Strike Rouge is a dead copy of the Strike Gundam, but
with the newly developed "Power Extender" battery pack and
a piloting-support AI it performs better than the Strike
Gundam overall.
MG Strike Gundam + IWSP

The "1/100 Scale MG Strike Gundam + IWSP" Gunpla.

The Strike Gundam, the first machine of Kira Yamato, hero
of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" and "SEED DESTINY", equipped
with the "IWSP", the Integrated Weapons Striker Pack.

The Strike Gundam is one of the GAT-X series developed by
the Atlantic Federation, a member of the Earth Alliance,
under its "G-Weapon Development Project". Its greatest
feature is changing equipment with the "Striker Pack
System". The IWSP is a multi-purpose Striker Pack: on top
of the Aile Striker's mobility, it carries large-caliber
railguns for long range and anti-ship swords for close
combat.
MG Freedom Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Freedom Gundam" Gunpla.

The Freedom Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED" and "SEED DESTINY". It was developed by ZAFT, but
Kira Yamato took it and made it his own.

Its nuclear engine gives its weapons far greater output,
letting it fire its long-range, high-power guns at once:
the Xiphias rail cannons on its waist and the Balaena
plasma beam cannons on its back. Its greatest feature, the
ten wing binders on its back, change shape between
High-Mat Mode and Full Burst Mode as the situation
demands.
MG Strike Freedom Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Strike Freedom Gundam" Gunpla.

The Strike Freedom Gundam is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Gundam SEED DESTINY". Built as the personal machine of
Kira Yamato, the Ultimate Coordinator, it pushes every
spec to the limit.

It has the Xiphias 3 rail cannons developed from the
Freedom's weapons, the powerful Callidus multi-phase beam
cannon in its abdomen, all-range attacks with the Super
DRAGOON mobile weapon wings on its back, and the Full
Burst that fires all of these together with its
high-energy beam rifles, giving it astonishing firepower.
MG Astray Red Frame

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/100 Scale Gundam Astray Red Frame"
converted to MG spec. The box is the 1/100 scale one, but
it contains MG-spec runners.

The Astray Red Frame is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED ASTRAY". It uses the flexible frame of the P0 series,
which can move almost like a human, to fight with Bajiquan
and swordplay. Its greatest feature is the "Gerbera
Straight" at its waist, a katana for MS with a blade of
fearsome sharpness and durability.
MG Astray Red Frame Kai

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Astray Red Frame Kai" Gunpla.

The Astray Red Frame Kai is an upgraded Astray Red Frame
from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED VS ASTRAY".

It adds the multi-purpose backpack "Tactical Arms IIL" and
the solid sword "Tiger Pierce", and can attack with two
swords, the Gerbera Straight and Tiger Pierce, or with the
giant sword of the Tactical Arms Sword Form. The Tactical
Arms can also change into Flight Form, which lets it fly,
and Arrow Form, which fires a powerful beam.
MG Astray Blue Frame

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Astray Blue Frame" Gunpla.

The Astray Blue Frame is one of the P0 series prototypes
secretly developed by Morgenroete in "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED ASTRAY".

It was developed as "a test machine for option equipment
specs" and can use all kinds of weapons. Its structure
also makes it fairly easy to add option sets.
MG Astray Blue Frame Second Revise

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Astray Blue Frame Second
Revise" Gunpla.

The Astray Blue Frame Second Revise is a redesign of the
"Second L", an upgraded Astray Blue Frame from "Mobile
Suit Gundam SEED VS ASTRAY".

It improves on the Blue Frame's shoulders, torso and legs,
and carries the multi-purpose backpack "Tactical Arms II".
The Tactical Arms can change into Flight Form, which lets
it fly, Sword Form, a giant sword, and Gatling Form, a
fixed gun emplacement for MS.
MG Astray Green Frame

A special Gunpla set prepared only for Gunpla Battle
events: the "1/100 Scale Gundam Astray Green Frame"
converted to MG spec. The box is the 1/100 scale one, but
it contains MG-spec runners.

The Astray Green Frame is one of the P0 series prototypes
secretly developed by Morgenroete in "Mobile Suit Gundam
SEED FRAME ASTRAYS". Its sensors and AI work together to
analyze the battle and dodge with great skill. It excels
at hand-to-hand combat, which Toroya learned as a student
of Barry, the "Fist God".
MG 00 Gundam

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 MG 00 Gundam" Gunpla.

The 00 Gundam is the machine of Setsuna F. Seiei, a Gundam
Meister of Celestial Being, in "Mobile Suit Gundam 00".

It was the first machine with the Twin Drive System, which
runs two GN Drives in sync to square the amount of GN
particles produced. Syncing the drives is difficult and it
never ran fully stable on its own, but even so the Twin
Drive's high output gives it astonishing power that
overwhelms all others.
MG 00 Raiser

The "1/100 Scale MG 00 Raiser" Gunpla.

The 00 Raiser is the 00 Gundam from "Mobile Suit Gundam
00" docked with its support unit, the O Raiser.

The stabilizer in the O Raiser brings the Twin Drive
System fully into sync, unlocking 100％ of its true
performance. Seen as an MS beyond Gundam, it is called the
00 Raiser, without "Gundam" in its name. When it activates
"Trans-Am", releasing all its stored high-density
particles, its strength is on another level entirely.
MG Susanowo

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Susanowo" Gunpla.

The Susanowo is a machine from "Mobile Suit Gundam 00", an
upgraded version of the Masurao, a close-combat machine
built for Mr. Bushido and his obsession with defeating the
Gundams.

Its armor is shaped like a samurai's, and it is armed with
the enhanced sabers "Shiranui" and "Unryu". Like the
Masurao, it can activate Trans-Am even though it runs on a
pseudo-solar furnace.
MG Unicorn Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Unicorn Gundam" Gunpla.

The Unicorn Gundam is an Earth Federation Forces
anti-Newtype Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit
Gundam Unicorn". It is the first machine ever built with a
full psycho-frame, and responds to its pilot far better
than earlier psycho-frame machines.

It carries the NT-D system: when it senses a hostile
Newtype, it transforms from Unicorn Mode, pure white with
a single-horn blade antenna, into Destroy Mode, with its
armor opening to expose a red-glowing psycho-frame, a
V-shaped antenna and a Gundam-type face.
MG Banshee

The "1/100 Scale MG Banshee" Gunpla.

The Banshee is an Earth Federation Forces anti-Newtype
Gundam-type mobile suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn".
"Banshee" is a nickname; its official name is "Unicorn
Gundam Unit 2".

Where Unit 1 is modeled on a unicorn, this one is modeled
on a lion, and together with its black armor the design
feels sinister. Like Unit 1 it carries the NT-D system,
and transforms from an almost all-black Unicorn Mode into
a Destroy Mode that exposes a golden psycho-frame.
MG Sinanju

The "1/100 Scale MG Sinanju" Gunpla.

The Sinanju is the machine of Full Frontal, leader of the
Neo Zeon remnant "the Sleeves", in "Mobile Suit Gundam
Unicorn".

A Newtype-only machine that uses psycho-frame in part of
its body, it is in a sense a sibling of the Unicorn
Gundam. After the Sleeves stole it, it was modified with
improved controls and stronger thrusters, and repainted
crimson from head to toe.

For its overwhelming combat power and crimson look, it and
its pilot Frontal are called "the Red Comet reborn".
MG Zaku Minelayer

The "1/100 Scale MG Zaku Minelayer" Gunpla.

The Zaku Minelayer, from "Mobile Suit Variations (MSV)",
is a Zaku II F whose backpack was replaced with a large
backpack for laying mines.

It can operate longer than a normal Zaku II F and has
communications as good as a commander's machine, but the
weight of the backpack makes it sluggish.
MG Garma Zabi's Zaku II FS Type

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Garma Zabi's Zaku II FS Type" Gunpla.

Garma Zabi's Zaku II is a Zeon machine from "Mobile Suit
Variations (MSV)", the personal machine of Garma Zabi,
fourth son of Sovereign Degwin Zabi.

It has improved melee ability and four vulcan guns in its
head, but its basic abilities are not much different from
a normal Zaku II F. It is less a "high-performance
machine" than a "luxury machine".
MG High Mobility Type Zaku II

The "1/100 Scale MG Shin Matsunaga's Zaku II" (High
Mobility Type Zaku II) Gunpla.

Shin Matsunaga's Zaku II is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Variations (MSV)". Its model is an improved High Mobility
Type Zaku II (MS-06R-1A).

A high-mobility space combat version developed to improve
on the Zaku II F. It looks much like earlier Zakus, but
its internals changed so much that it is effectively a
different mobile suit.
MG Johnny Ridden's Zaku II

The "1/100 Scale MG Johnny Ridden's Zaku II" Gunpla.

Johnny Ridden's Zaku II is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Variations (MSV)": the one Major Johnny Ridden piloted of
the only four late-type High Mobility Zaku IIs (MS-06R-2)
ever built.

It still looks like a Zaku, as if only its legs and back
were changed, but its internals changed so much from the
R-1A that in performance it is a completely different
machine. That is why it was called "a Gelgoog in Zaku's
clothing".
MG Dom Tropen (Sand Brown)

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Dom Tropen (Sand Brown)" Gunpla.

The Dom Tropen is a heavy mobile suit for desert and
tropical use from "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust
Memory" and other works.

A Dom redesigned and improved for local combat, with
stronger armor and better mobility. Its leg jet engines
are fitted with dust filters for fighting in deserts and
extreme heat.
MG Qubeley Mk-II

The "1/100 Scale MG Qubeley Mk-II" Gunpla.

The Qubeley Mk-II is a Neo Zeon Newtype-only machine from
"Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", piloted by Elpeo Ple.

A minor update of the original Qubeley piloted by Haman
Karn, developed with mass production in mind. It is
slightly detuned from the original, but its outstanding
mobility and all-range funnel attacks are intact, and it
is among the best-performing MS of Neo Zeon.
MG G-3 Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG G-3 Gundam" Gunpla.

The G-3 Gundam is a prototype mobile suit developed under
the Earth Federation Forces' "Operation V".

It is the third Gundam unit, given a magnetic coating that
greatly improves its response and fitted with some newer
parts. It is colored mainly gray.
MG Gundam Mk-II Titans

The "1/100 Scale MG Gundam Mk-II (Titans Colors)" Gunpla.

The Gundam Mk-II (Titans Colors) is a machine from "Mobile
Suit Zeta Gundam". The true successor to the Gundam,
developed by the Earth Federation special forces "Titans"
from the legendary "Gundam" with the latest technology.

A groundbreaking machine, the first to use a movable
frame, with excellent mobility and high overall
performance. Unlike the original Gundam, it is painted the
dark blue known as "Titans colors".
MG Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga" Gunpla.

Rezin Schnyder's Geara Doga is a machine from "Mobile Suit
Gundam: Char's Counterattack": the Geara Doga, the new Neo
Zeon's main mass-production machine, modified as a
commander's machine for Rezin Schnyder.

It is painted blue, Rezin Schnyder's personal color, and
the commander's blade antenna on its head improves its
communications.
MG Dreissen

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Dreissen (Unicorn Ver.)" Gunpla.

The Dreissen is a Neo Zeon mass-production heavy mobile
suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" and "Mobile Suit Gundam
Unicorn". In "Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn" it was
repainted, given the Sleeves' decorations and used to
defend the Neo Zeon remnant "the Sleeves".

The final development of the Dom line, with a sturdy build
and high mobility. Unlike the Dom, which focuses on
bombardment, it is armed for close range with a beam
tomahawk, Tri-Blades and more.
MG ZZ Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG ZZ Gundam" Gunpla.

The ZZ Gundam is a general-purpose heavy assault mobile
suit from "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ", an AEUG machine piloted
by the hero Judau Ashta.

A high-performance machine with high output, high mobility
and high firepower: it has several generators, each strong
enough to run an MS on its own, and battleship-class
weapons led by the High Mega Cannon. It stands at one peak
of the "dinosaur-like evolution" of the late U.C. 0080s,
when a single MS was expected to do everything.
MG Turn A Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Turn A Gundam" Gunpla.

The Turn A Gundam is a machine from "Turn A Gundam",
piloted by Loran Cehack and used by the Inglessa Militia
and others.

A machine dug out of a stone statue in a Mountain Cycle,
called the "White Doll" or "Mustache" for its looks. In
truth it is the fearsome machine that once turned every
man-made thing to sand with its "Moonlight Butterfly"
system and buried Earth's civilization. In the story it is
said never to show most of its performance, but its hidden
power is immeasurable.
MG Crossbone Gundam X1

The "1/100 Scale MG Crossbone Gundam X1" Gunpla.

The Crossbone Gundam X1 is the MS used by Kincade Nau of
the space pirates Crossbone Vanguard in "Mobile Suit
Crossbone Gundam".

Its pirate-style decorations and large X-shaped back
thrusters are its trademarks. The first MS built in the
Earth Sphere for the outer planets, its back thrusters
keep it highly mobile even in Jupiter's strong gravity.
Designed for close combat, it carries many close-combat
weapons all over its body.
MG Destiny Gundam

The "1/100 Scale MG Destiny Gundam" Gunpla.

The Destiny Gundam is the ultimate all-purpose machine
from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY", packed with all of
ZAFT's best technology to end the war with the Earth
Alliance.

Its "Hyper Deuterion" engine gives it enormous output, and
its many high-output weapons for every situation give it
the firepower and mobility to overwhelm enemies at any
range, near or far.
MG Gundam X

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Gundam X" ("1/100 Scale HG Gundam X"
in MG spec) Gunpla.

The Gundam X is a decisive-battle MS developed by the
former Earth Federation Forces as a trump card in the 7th
Space War, in "After War Gundam X". After the war, Garrod
Ran found it and made it his own.

Its greatest feature is the strategic weapon on its back,
the "Satellite Cannon", which at full output can destroy a
colony in one shot. Its basic performance as an MS is also
high, with sturdy armor and great versatility on any
terrain.
MG Build Strike Gundam Full Package

A special limited item made only for Gunpla Battle events:
the "1/100 Scale MG Build Strike Gundam Full Package"
Gunpla.

The Build Strike Gundam Full Package is a Gunpla from
"Gundam Build Fighters" that combines the Build Strike
Gundam, custom-built by Sei Iori, with the Build Booster
flight unit.

It is very mobile and excels at quick attacks. It is built
with great skill on the base of the Strike Gundam from
"Mobile Suit Gundam SEED", but its weapons are still
unfinished and there is room to grow. A Gunpla that will
keep evolving.
